'''Nathan Blyskipper''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] in [[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nathan Blyskipper was a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December]] 15, [[2011]].
